top_signals.title: World Bank Warns Asia Is Running Out of Money to Fight Energy Shock
top_signals.summary: Asian countries have responded more aggressively than others to the energy supply crunch caused by the U.S. and Israeli war on Iran and now they are running out of resources to continue their response, the World Bank warned in a new report. The report actually focuses on the potential of artificial intelligence to help Asian economies grow but names energy import vulnerability as one major headwind to that growth. “Subsidies have been by far the most common policy response [to the crisis] among emerging and developing economies,” the…

Informa snaps up Clarion Events in £2.2bn deal with Blackstone
top_signals.summary: Digital services giant Informa has snapped up the world’s largest privately owned event and exhibition organiser in a multi-billion pound deal with private equity firm Blackstone. The FTSE 100 group revealed on Tuesday it had acquired London-headquartered Clarion Events for £2.2bn from Blackstone.
